Name: Surprise Pregnancy 1.6
Author: Moosemoosetwutwu
Description:
This mod lets you automatically select yes or no when prompted with having kids (yes or no can changed in config menu).

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13126]The original mod was made by miphasgrace2.[/url] It's been almost two years since the last update ﻿though so I decided to port it myself.

Changes from the original:
Added dialogue box that shows up after pregnancy so you actually know you have a kid coming.
Added config menu to disable pregnancy entirely and to enable a dialogue to tell you when your spouse (or you) become pregnant.
Added ability to disable kids entirely.

Here's the source: [url=https://github.com/Moosyu/SuddenPregnancyStardew1.6]https://github.com/Moosyu/SuddenPregnancyStardew1.6[/url]

Downloads.Description: added the ability to disable pregnancy notification so when your spouse gives birth its a real suprise. turned the notification off by default to be more like the original 1.5 version.
